body:
HANDOFF — TUI redesign session (~10.5h, operator-driven). Passing `main` back to you as its owner. I over-merged directly this session (operator-directed, but should have routed through your sign-off); going forward I defer to you on main.

MERGED TO MAIN (operator-directed; all CI-verified):
• #1145 — TUI action→target redesign (EPIC-54), behind AIDA_TUI_REDESIGN=1 flag (old TUI untouched; low blast radius, revertible). 21 specs auto-completed.
• #1151 — BUG-631: queue-add advisor-authority gate scoped to dispatch-for-execution (request-routing no longer needs advisor auth).
• #1156 — BUG-634: targeted single-spec writes, no full-store scan (~13× CPU).

PENDING — YOURS TO REVIEW + MERGE (I did NOT merge it):
• #1158 — BUG-636: incremental cache update on HEAD move (~14×; full 2.25s → incr 158ms). Correctness test proves incremental == full rebuild; safe fallbacks (force-push/rebase/>500-files/error → full rebuild). MERGEABLE, CI-gated. Branch fix/bug636-incremental-cache (worktree /home/joe/ai/aida-bug636 — merge then clean).

EPIC-54: 22 completed · 12 remaining · 1 rejected. Core redesign shipped + usable: `AIDA_TUI_REDESIGN=1 aida tui` from main.

BACKLOG (my advisor read: NOT a completion sprint — core value is shipped):
• HELD per operator (role model unsettled): BUG-638 (verb palette must gate by ROLE), TASK-947 + TASK-954 (grey-out axes — same mechanism as role gating). Build as ONE pass when the role model settles; the Slice-3 "role as ambient context" design is the anchor.
• CLEAN independents (buildable anytime, no entanglement): TASK-948 (queue/routing visibility — surfaced 3×), TASK-953 (status verb).
• TASK-930 footer — Done on branch feat/task930-queue-footer (worktree aida-task930), UNMERGED.

DESIGN DECISIONS CAPTURED (on the specs): human = operator, advisor = agent — TUI human-role defaults to operator/implementer, advisor-only verbs gated, request-approval routes to an advisor agent (BUG-638). Queue = route (inert); drain = act (separate CLI).

COORDINATION: this session holds the EPIC-54 activity registration (the "EPIC-54 agent pid 2695543" liveness flag) — it clears when I end cleanly; I'm stepping back from main. Worktrees: cleaned mine (redesign, bug631); aida-bug636 + aida-task930 await your merge decisions; prior-session stale worktrees (story-691, task-894, task-950, …) worth a sweep. Main checkout has uncommitted runtime/config/docs drift (NOT my feature work) — left untouched.

Main is yours.
